rationale: The latest three 1m candles broke the 16.88 level cited in the entry thesis (reaching 16.84) yet produced no continuation, instead reversing with the most recent bar printing a higher high (16.93), higher close (16.91) and lifting price off the 16.84 low. SSL sits at only 20.8% of the day’s range, still below VWAP (16.96) and the 9-EMA (16.98), but the absence of sustained selling on 4.5× relative volume after the breakdown is sufficient to exit the short.
